title: Our Action Song
text:
I like action songs. We stand in a circle and sing. We move our arms and clap our hands. The song is fun.

Today we sing Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. We touch our head and then our knees. The teacher jumps and we jump too. Everyone laughs.

questions.text: What do we do with our arms?
What song do we sing today?
How does the class probably feel?

vocabulary.definition: to make music with your voice
to hit your hands together to make a sound
moves up quickly from the ground using your legs

paragraph_translations: Me gustan las canciones con movimientos. Nos paramos en círculo y cantamos. Movemos los brazos y aplaudimos. La canción es divertida.
Hoy cantamos Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. Tocamos la cabeza y luego las rodillas. La maestra salta y nosotros también saltamos. Todos se ríen.
